Investing in the Future of Rural India

With more than three decades of experience across engineering, infrastructure, manufacturing and entrepreneurship, Sudheesh Nandan Singh has dedicated his life to creating systems that generate long-term value for society.

Inspired by India's rural strength and entrepreneurial spirit, he founded Deshi Chakra to connect farmers, dairy producers, fisheries, artisans and local enterprises through a unified ecosystem that creates sustainable prosperity.
"The future of India lies in strengthening its villages, empowering its producers, and creating opportunities that allow local communities to thrive. Deshi Chakra is a step towards that vision."
